reason: All deliverables exist and work: a real 2-level Cargo workspace with workspace [lints], per-member lints opt-in, clippy.toml, rustfmt.toml, an executable check.sh, and a prek-wired .pre-commit-config.yaml. Real prek 0.5.9 and cargo-machete 0.9.2 binaries are installed locally; check.sh and the prescribed 'prek run --all-files' both pass with genuine cargo tool output, and a reinjected unwrap makes clippy -D warnings fail (exit 101), proving the lint policy is live.
